readerCopy.body: A useful message can remove one small obstacle that has been keeping a larger move hypothetical. When Mercury sextiles the North Node, communication and forward movement cooperate through a reply, introduction, document, or well-timed conversation. The information does not have to explain the whole future. One concrete exchange can make the possibility easier to judge because the next question, call, or decision finally has something factual to work with.
